query:
SELECT l.discord_id,
                   p.deadlock_stage,
                   p.deadlock_minutes,
                   COALESCE(p.deadlock_updated_at, p.last_seen_at) AS "fresh?"
            FROM core.steam_links l
            JOIN activity.live_player_state p ON p.steam_id = l.steam_id
            WHERE l.verified = TRUE
